adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` the diff changes the reference object construction so that `credentialId` is only set when `isCalendarType` is true. Specifically, around ~164 it becomes `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined`, whereas previously the non-calendar branch stored `result.credentialId`. This is a concrete behavioral change: for non-calendar (e.g., video/conferencing) creations, the stored reference will now have `credentialId: undefined`, which can break later operations that rely on `reference.credentialId` to target the correct credential for update/delete.
